$comment: Curated catalog of optional flamapy plugins the IDE's Manage Plugins dialog can install at runtime, in addition to the three bundled-and-enabled defaults (sat, bdd, z3) in plugins.conf.json. Each entry is installed via micropip (see public/flamapy/flamapy.js installPlugin). `wheelRefs` are micropip targets: bundled paths served from public/flamapy ('flamapy/<name>-<ver>.whl') or absolute URLs. Because installPlugin uses deps=False, `wheelRefs` must list every dependency wheel and `pyodidePackages` every native package served by Pyodide. Set `available:false` (with empty wheelRefs) for plugins whose solver needs a native extension for which no Pyodide/wasm wheel exists yet — the dialog shows these disabled with `note`. When a wasm wheel is built, flip `available:true` and fill wheelRefs with the versioned filenames (nothing stamps them here; clean-old-wheels keeps registry-referenced wheels).

plugins.label: SDD
plugins.description: Sentential Decision Diagram backend (flamapy-sdd). Adds satisfiable, configurations number, core and dead features via an SDD compilation of the model.
plugins.note: SDD compilation (UCLA libsdd 2.0 via PySDD) compiled to WebAssembly.

plugins.label: d-DNNF
plugins.description: Deterministic Decomposable Negation Normal Form backend (flamapy-dnnf) for exact model counting and related analyses.
plugins.note: Requires the external d4 compiler invoked via subprocess; not portable to Pyodide (no process spawning in the browser) without porting d4 to wasm and rewriting the plugin to call it in-process.

plugins.label: #SAT
plugins.description: Sharp-SAT backend (flamapy-sharpsat) for (approximate) configuration counting on large models.
plugins.note: Approximate counting (ApproxMC) and almost-uniform sampling (UniGen) compiled to WebAssembly.
